description:
A castle of the Hofmark of Steinakirchen, held by the Bishop of Regensburg, first stood on the site, on a plateau above a steep slope down to the Kleine Erlauf, according to German Wikipedia, the main source for this chronology. In the 16th century a four-winged castle with a projecting corner tower and an arcaded courtyard with a stair tower was built here, from 1527 by Wolfgang von Öder zu Götzendorf and his descendants and from 1596 by Reichard Streun von Schwarzenau.

Since 1656 the castle has belonged to the Counts of Auersperg. The chapel, with a groin vault, is recorded in 1330 and was dedicated to St Bartholomew in 1675. The courtyard has three-storey arcaded galleries on three sides, decorated with painted trompe-l'oeil architecture.

West of the castle lies a 19th-century landscape garden with a spruce avenue and an obelisk to Count Joseph of Auersperg, who fell at the Battle of Austerlitz. Today the castle operates as a hotel, with breakfast served on a terrace.
history: A medieval castle belonging to the Bishop of Regensburg's Hofmark of Steinakirchen first stood above the Kleine Erlauf. In the 16th century it was replaced by a four-winged Renaissance castle with a corner tower and an arcaded courtyard, built from 1527 by the Öder family and continued from 1596 by Reichard Streun von Schwarzenau. Since 1656 the castle has belonged to the Counts of Auersperg. Its chapel is recorded in 1330, and a 19th-century landscape garden with an obelisk to a count killed at Austerlitz lies to the west. Today the castle operates as a hotel.

faqs.question: Who owns Schloss Ernegg?
faqs.answer: The castle has belonged to the Counts of Auersperg since 1656.

faqs.question: Do all rooms at Schloss Ernegg have a private bathroom?
faqs.answer: No. The entry-level Standard Double Rooms on Booking share a bathroom; the Deluxe Double Rooms have a private bathroom.

meta_title: Ernegg Castle, Mostviertel — Renaissance Castle Hotel
meta_description: Stay at Ernegg Castle, a Renaissance castle in the Mostviertel, Lower Austria — a castle hotel with an arcaded courtyard. From approx. €200/night.

hotel.room_location_note: Rooms are in the castle; the entry-level rooms on Booking share a bathroom, so check the room type before you book
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** The castle stands at Ernegg 1, in the municipality of Steinakirchen am Forst in the Mostviertel of Lower Austria, above the Kleine Erlauf. Booking lists free private parking, including accessible parking.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €200/night for an 18 m² Standard Double Room with two single beds and a shared bathroom, so the bathroom is not private; breakfast and free cancellation are included on the rate seen. If you want a private bathroom, the cheapest option was a 30 m² Deluxe Double Room with a bath, at around €255, and a Family Two-Bedroom Suite was around €370. Booking shows a small tax charge (about €5) separately, plus a member price that is not included here.

**On-site:** Breakfast on the castle terrace, massages, the landscape garden, free parking and free Wi-Fi; pets are welcome, with possible fees.

**Good to know:** The entry-level rooms share a bathroom, so the lowest price shown on this page is for a shared bathroom; check the room type before you book. Rates were seen for one May 2027 night, so check your own dates on Booking; Booking showed no availability for late January.

**Combine with:** [Artstetten Castle](/castles/austria/artstetten-castle), the burial place of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, about 22 km to the north-east.
